name: growth-memory
description: A local-first Codex plugin that helps agents use rookcue for task recovery, review, and personal knowledge promotion.

interface.shortDescription: Turn AI-assisted work into recoverable project memory and reviewed personal knowledge.
interface.longDescription: RookCue teaches Codex to use the local rookcue CLI as a background protocol for non-trivial coding work. It records task progress, recommends lightweight reviews, and promotes personal knowledge only after human approval.
defaultPrompt: Use rookcue for this coding task.
Recommend a lightweight review for this task.
